finding.summary: The aggregate field joint_endpoint_eligible_count and the conditional-minimum population apply an unregistered valid=true filter, while the sealed plan defines joint endpoint eligibility only by the two >=5% endpoint improvements.

implementation.cause: eligible includes row[guards][valid] before row[guards][joint_endpoint_eligible], and minimum() reuses that filtered population

bounded_impact.authority: The coincidentally unchanged primary classification does not cure the prospective field-semantics violation; R452 cannot register a scientific claim. A successor may reuse the immutable verified shards and must reseal corrected offline aggregation semantics.
